bundles.evidenceText: libertarian free will doesn't matter at all because having it wouldn't give you responsibility not having it wouldn't take it away from you
bundles.rationale: The positive priority rule assigns this independent claim that libertarian freedom cannot generate responsibility to the narrower indeterminacy subsidiary. The default is no bridge without advancement; the central sourcehood and motion bridges are excluded because the move neither invokes beyond-control sourcehood nor establishes the complete no-basic-desert result.
